description: Distributions whose metadata carries no usable licence expression (DEPT28_SPEC C.7.2, D13: exceptions by name with a reason). proof kinds: 'file' = the bundled licence file inside the installed dist-info whose first line is re-read by the gate; 'sibling' = another installed distribution from the same source repository whose License-Expression the gate re-reads; 'stated' = a licence verified outside the venv (the pinned repository's LICENSE, sha256 recorded) that the gate cannot re-read — accepted by name with the reason, as D13 allows. The spec's list named only lark-oapi and agent-client-protocol (df-state); the resolved runtime set needed four more (recorded in ADR 0011). lark-oapi is a gateway dependency and is NOT in this service's runtime set (spec 0.3); its entry is inert while the distribution is absent. Round 18 R9: every 'file' entry names the proof file AND its first line; the gate re-reads both and accepts nothing file-sourced without an entry. Round 19 R13: 'bundled_licence_file' = the distribution's own licence is on the allowlist but it ships a second licence file for a bundled component under a different licence; the gate names that file's licence and refuses the distribution unless an entry states the component and the reason (an operator ruling, recorded in ADR 0011).

lark-oapi.reason: METADATA has License-File only; the bundled LICENSE is the MIT text (df-state)

agent-client-protocol.reason: METADATA has no License-Expression; the bundled licenses/LICENSE is the Apache-2.0 text (df-state)

deerflow-harness.reason: deer-flow repository LICENSE at commit 345f08be00c8a9495079b732a39b46aa9af1584e is the MIT text (sha256 b23dff4d4bac8d17b6efaaa7e88c2b730149c4dda45699ce676b719cfdffe7e1; VERDICT: 'deer-flow itself is MIT'); the harness subpackage pyproject declares no license field and the git-built dist-info carries no licence file

deerflow-extension-api.reason: same repository and commit as deerflow-harness (backend/packages/extension-api); no license metadata in its pyproject

protobuf-py-ext.reason: native extension built from the same repository (github.com/bufbuild/protobuf-py) as protobuf-py, whose METADATA carries License-Expression: Apache-2.0; the repository LICENSE is Apache-2.0 (verified 2026-09-27); the ext wheel ships no licence metadata

sqlite-vec.reason: METADATA License field reads 'MIT License, Apache License, Version 2.0' (dual-licensed); the gate normalises the comma list and accepts MIT

dotenv.reason: dotenv 0.9.9 (a deer-flow transitive dependency) declares License: UNKNOWN; the bundled LICENSE in its dist-info is the MIT text (first line 'MIT License'); round 18 R9: a file-sourced licence passes only through this entry

tiktoken.reason: tiktoken 0.14.0 pastes the whole MIT text into its License field (no expression, no classifier); the bundled licenses/LICENSE is the MIT text (first line 'MIT License'); round 18 R9
